World Tree: Water Fight

GameplayEvent Rules8 sections
Basic Rules

◆ During the World Tree: Water Fight Competition, you can join forces with fellow adventurers to explore the majestic World Tree and conquer its challenges.

◆ Remember, exploration takes its toll, so keep an eye on your Stamina! Climb toward the top floor and claim the ultimate prize.

Team Rules

◆ You are free to create, join, leave, or even disband teams as you see fit.

◆ However, creating a team isn't free after your first one. Be prepared to spend some Crystals if you want to build another squad.

World Tree Exploration

◆ Transcender Power = the Total Power of Fellows * Percentage Bonus + Fixed Bonus.

◆ Every trek through the World Tree saps your Stamina. The amount consumed depends on the area you're venturing into. Richfield Farms: 1 Stamina; Blooming Forest: 2 Stamina; Mossy Wetland: 3 Stamina; Dark Forest: 4 Stamina; Top Floor: 5 Stamina.

◆ Stamina regenerates over time: 1 point every 20 minutes. No regeneration upon reaching limit. You can also guzzle an Energy Drink for a quicker boost during the event.

◆ During each exploration, you'll face new events that could bring you sweet rewards such as items, weapons, and loot.

◆ Items and weapons power up Transcenders, but they're not unlimited. Each one has a set number of charges before it is automatically discarded. Use them wisely to take down powerful foes.

◆ Loot includes magic spores and bursting pods scattered throughout the World Tree. These magical goodies permanently boost Transcender power while the event is active, and you can stack them for an even bigger advantage. Remember, these disappear once the event ends.

Mark Opponent

◆ When running into an opponent that's giving your team a serious beatdown, mark them for help from your teammates.

◆ Each Transcender can only mark one opponent at a time.

◆ Once marked, the opponent gets added to your team's Support Zone, and you will score bonus points for taking them down.

Area Map

◆ Transcenders can travel to different areas by completing certain challenges during World Tree exploration.

◆ The World Tree consists of 5 different areas: 1. Richfield Farms 2. Blooming Forest 3. Mossy Wetland 4. Dark Forest 5. Top Floor.

◆ Transcenders can get points in each area. The higher you climb, the more points and rewards, and the tougher the trials and the fiercer the opponents.

World Tree Buds

◆ During exploration, Transcenders can pick Lunar Blossom Buds and Solar Blossom Buds from the World Tree.

◆ Transcenders can use Lunar Essence and Solar Essence during the event to open the corresponding buds and receive rewards.

◆ Locked World Tree Buds will disappear once the event wraps.

Arena

◆ Once Transcenders reach the Mossy Wetland, they can enter the Arena and be matched against challengers of similar rank.

◆ In Arena, choose one of Fellows to fight alongside you. However, each Fellow can only enter the Arena once per day.

◆ Fellow ATK = Fellow Power. Fellow HP = Fellow Power.

◆ After selecting a fellow, Transcenders can purchase energy drinks from sponsors to give themselves a power-up.

◆ During battle, Transcenders must choose one of the three challengers sent by the opponent. If victorious, Transcenders earn an additional opportunity to purchase energy drinks.

◆ Loot collected during exploration grants power bonuses in the Arena.

◆ Achieving victories in the Arena earns you points and boosts your rankings.

◆ Defeating all three challengers sent by the opponent grants win streak rewards. At the end of the battle, Transcenders also receive settlement rewards.

Leaderboard and Rewards

◆ Ranking: Personal Ranking is determined by the score each Transcender accumulates during the event. Team Ranking is based on the combined scores of all team members during the event.

◆ Rewards: After the event concludes, claim your rewards based on your Personal Ranking and Team Ranking.

◆ As the event is held multiple times, the variety of rewards will become increasingly rich, and an exchange shop will be opened for redeeming rare rewards.
